This board owns PRDs under prds/. Source changes belong to the project three
levels above. Always pass this board path explicitly to the configured engine.

grammar: project
subject: Project development vocabulary
---

A PRD owns one observable outcome. A spec defines an implementable change and
its proof. A board records dependencies, claims and authoritative PRD state.

# Project board

This owner-shipped template declares settings, document templates and workflows.
Create authored work under prds/<name>/prd.md with the PRD template. Templates
are examples, not active work. Do not copy state into another record.

Configure the external PRD engine and always select this board explicitly.
Engine installation and its pinned integration contract are separate from
initialization. This template contains no engine implementation.

Preview initialization before applying it. Existing identical files are kept;
edited files are reported and preserved. A partial install is recoverable by
an explicit retry after inspecting the preview. No existing files are replaced,
including old staging files left by a process crash.

# One observable outcome

Describe the current problem and the resulting behavior. Inherit the source
repository from board settings, or declare an explicit owner repository.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The desired behavior has observed proof.
- [ ] Invalid input and failure preserve existing work.
- [ ] Recovery is explicit and reproducible.

## Proof and recovery

Record the source revision and disposable baseline before writing specs.
Document the exact verification command and recovery boundary.

---
complexity: small
footprint: []
---

# One implementable change

Replace the empty footprint with actual owner-relative source paths.

## Acceptance

- [ ] One observable requirement is satisfied.

## Verify and Proof

Add a shell block with a probed verification command before implementation.

---
workflow: develop
subject: Develop and verify one bounded outcome
---

## Use when

A dependency-ready PRD names this workflow.

## Steps

| # | atomic | why | on failure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `analyze` | Baseline and bounded specs establish what must change. | `stop` |
| 2 | `verify` | Implementation and recovery match observed proof. | `stop` |

---
atomic: analyze
subject: Establish a baseline and bounded specs
---

## Do

Read owner instructions and dependencies. Probe the behavior in a disposable
fixture. Record source revision, exact command and observed result. Write
specs with narrow footprints, observable acceptance and executable proof.

## Done when

The baseline and specs are recorded and dependencies resolve.

## Fails when

| seen | means | do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Missing baseline or owner | Work is not yet executable. | Stop and resolve it. |

---
atomic: verify
subject: Implement and prove the accepted specs
---

## Do

Implement the accepted specs. Run the declared tests and recovery fixtures.
Preserve failed evidence. Record source revisions and exact verification results.
Use the configured engine's checked transitions to integrate verified work.

## Done when

Every acceptance has observed proof at the integrated source revision.

## Fails when

| seen | means | do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A verification fails | Completion is not established. | Preserve work and repair it. |

expected: Generated board exposes an explicit portable entry to its pinned maintained PRD engine
observed: Native generation succeeds and existing maintained engine plan works when called directly with explicit --board. Generated board has neither engine pin manifest nor invocation adapter; external Pearde CLI is no longer maintained authority.
